# Weft 1.0.58
- Load workspace connection targets only while the connection picker is open, avoiding repeated repository-wide discovery in the overview. - Coalesce overlapping connection refreshes and reuse validated routing settings and registries until their files change. - Avoid publishing unchanged interface state and redrawing the menu-bar icon on every session update. - Skip ordinary source files early when scanning for dependency and configuration restart triggers, with a 15-second fallback interval for configuration and branch checks. - Reduce background check and repository polling, with longer intervals in the background and Low Power Mode. - Inspect Git status without refreshing the index or waking metadata watchers. - Preserve registered workspace routing, fallback addresses and shared sign-in relay compatibility. - Wait for dependency build readiness before starting services, preventing overlapping builds during workspace restoration. - Provide a local Release reservation action for stale agent holds.
Requires macOS 26 or later and Apple silicon. Versions through 1.0.52 require one manual installation to enable in-app updates.
